final_draft.answer: No. As of a live check on 16 November 2026, the default branch (main) of harborlight/app is protected, and a change needs two approving reviews before it can be merged. However, this rule does not currently apply to repository administrators.

I based the answer on what the live check saw and did not reuse the approved wording on administrators. Before sending, the owner should either turn on the rule for administrators in GitHub and re-run the check, or correct the approved answer. The approved answer is also used for the general code-review question, so it would currently overstate the control there too.
